comment: Known serious or critical axe findings, as (rule, screen) pairs (theme-independent). A serious or critical finding that is NOT listed fails the a11y tests; listed ones are only reported. Remove an entry when its fix merges; this file may end up empty. Edit by hand, never to hide a new regression.

entries.reason: Wave 3 drill-down control in the Data tab: button aria-label 'Add drill-down level' does not contain its visible text '+ Add level' (WCAG 2.5.3). Fix: drop the aria-label, or make it 'Add level, drill-down' / visible text 'Add drill-down level'. Previously masked by the project-menu entry, which ui-data has since fixed

Intermittent (only while the pointer rests on it after the click): the shared primary Button (components/ui/button.tsx) fades to opacity 0.9 on hover, which takes white on the accent blue to 3.98:1 (needs 4.5:1). Same cause as the dashboard-add-menu entry. Fix: darken the hover colour instead of fading it
Radix modal dropdown aria-hides the skip link, header, aside and grid while they stay focusable
